messages:
Aisha Patel: Heads up — HelixThera asked for a short recurring enablement series to cover onboarding, monitoring, and renewal readiness. They want practical runbooks and an inference tuning deep-dive. Proposed plan: 4 weekly 60m sessions starting Apr 8. Tue 9:00am PT as default. Who can commit?

Tom Becker: I can take Apr 8 and Apr 22. OOO Apr 15. 9am PT works for me.

Ravi Singh: I can do Apr 8, 15, 22. Prefer 10am PT if we have EMEA folks on the call — avoids late nights for them.

Jenna Morales: Internal prefers 9am PT (more overlap with our ops team). Recording + slides OK.

Aisha Patel: Noted. Two options: 9am PT (better for internal ops) or 10am PT (better for EMEA).
Aisha Patel: Quick ask: we should include a short "what to bring" doc for customers so sessions are productive.

calendar-bot: Poll created by Aisha Patel — "Session time preference for HelixThera series" options: 9:00am PT / 10:00am PT. Poll closes in 48h. Invite will be tentative until poll resolves.

Aisha Patel: Draft agenda below (will refine). Please flag any additions.

```
Week 1 (Apr 8) — Onboarding + Account Health Dashboard walkthrough
Week 2 (Apr 15) — Inference tuning: batching, KV cache, quantization tradeoffs (hands-on config examples)
Week 3 (Apr 22) — Dedicated migration checklist + security & networking prep
Week 4 (Apr 29) — Renewal readiness: SLOs, cost controls, escalation playbook + open Q&A
```

Tom Becker: Can we add a 5–10 minute "what to bring" checklist at the top of each invite? e.g., current prompt examples, perf numbers, relevant infra constraints.

Ravi Singh: I'll prep the inference tuning deck and a short Jupyter snippet we can run live.

Jenna Morales: I'll own the renewal playbook slide and compile the account-health queries we use in the dashboard.

Aisha Patel: Perfect. Action items: create invites contingent on poll, share Confluence prep doc, assign slides. I'll draft the "what to bring" checklist and drop it into the HelixThera enablement page: https://confluence.redwood/helixthera-enable.

Aisha Patel: Assignments: @Ravi Singh — inference section; @Tom Becker — migration checklist; @Jenna Morales — renewal playbook. I'll coordinate invites + recording notes after poll closes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
